name: Task Form

error_codes.condition: Title is missing, empty, or whitespace-only after trim

business_logic: 1. Validate request → trim title; if empty after trim: return 400 VALIDATION_ERROR
2. Default status to 'todo' if not provided
3. INSERT new task row with generated id, provided/default fields, created_at=now, updated_at=now

data_operations.description: INSERT new task with title, due_date, status (default 'todo'), created_at, updated_at

edge_case_handling.handling: Return 400 VALIDATION_ERROR with message 'Title is required'

edge_case_handling.condition: User cancels (Cancel button, X icon, Escape key, or click-outside)
edge_case_handling.handling: Frontend-only — no API call made; modal closes without saving
Frontend-only — Save button disabled while request is in flight; only one POST call is sent per submit

business_rules_applied: A title consisting only of whitespace is treated as missing
Status defaults to 'Todo' for new tasks

unit_test_cases.description: returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR when title is missing or whitespace-only after trim
unit_test_cases.given: request body title is '' or '   ' (whitespace-only) — trim(title) === ''
unit_test_cases.expect: throw ValidationException with code VALIDATION_ERROR, message 'Title is required'

unit_test_cases.description: defaults status to 'todo' when status is not provided
unit_test_cases.given: request body has valid title 'Buy milk' and no status field

unit_test_cases.description: returns success result when all conditions pass
unit_test_cases.given: request body has valid title 'Buy milk', optional dueDate and status; taskRepo.insert() returns the newly created row
unit_test_cases.expect: return 201 with created task { id, title, dueDate, status, createdAt, updatedAt }

endpoints.description: Update an existing task's title, due date, and/or status

body_schema.title: string (optional, non-empty after trim if present)

error_codes.condition: title is present in body but empty or whitespace-only after trim
Task with given id does not exist

business_logic: 1. Check task exists → if not found: return 404 NOT_FOUND
2. If title is present in body: trim; if empty after trim: return 400 VALIDATION_ERROR
3. UPDATE provided fields on the task, set updated_at=now

data_operations.description: UPDATE task SET title/due_date/status (only provided fields) WHERE id=?

edge_case_handling.condition: Title cleared or whitespace-only on edit
edge_case_handling.handling: Return 400 VALIDATION_ERROR with message 'Title is required'; task remains unchanged

edge_case_handling.condition: User cancels (Cancel button, X icon, Escape key, or click-outside)
edge_case_handling.handling: Frontend-only — no API call made; task remains unchanged
Frontend-only — Save button disabled while request is in flight; only one PATCH call is sent per submit

business_rules_applied: Task title is required and cannot be cleared on edit
A title consisting only of whitespace is treated as missing
Due date and status can be changed freely

unit_test_cases.description: returns 404 NOT_FOUND when task does not exist
returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR when title is present but empty or whitespace-only after trim
unit_test_cases.given: taskRepo.findById(id) returns an existing task; request body title is '   '
unit_test_cases.expect: throw ValidationException with code VALIDATION_ERROR, message 'Title is required'; task remains unchanged

unit_test_cases.description: returns success result when all conditions pass
unit_test_cases.given: taskRepo.findById(id) returns an existing task; request body has one or more valid fields; taskRepo.update() returns the updated row
unit_test_cases.expect: return 200 with updated task { id, title, dueDate, status, createdAt, updatedAt } and updatedAt refreshed

screen_dependencies.reason: Task Form is opened from and returns to the Task List on save/cancel

implementation_notes: Title validation must trim whitespace before checking emptiness (applies to both create and edit)
Save button disabled while a request is in flight, to prevent duplicate submissions on double-click
Modal dismissal via X icon, Escape key, or click-outside all route to the same cancel handler — no API call in any case
These two endpoints are the same ones already defined on the Task List screen's tech spec — kept consistent here from the Task Form's perspective

component_test.action: fill the Title field with a valid title and click Save
component_test.assert: Save request submitted successfully, form closes, success notification shown

browser_test.action: click Add Task, type a valid title into the Title field, click Save
browser_test.assert: modal closes, new task appears in the task list, success notification is shown

component_test.action: leave the Title field empty and click Save
component_test.assert: validation error shown under the Title field, form remains open, no save request completes

browser_test.action: open Add Task modal, leave the Title field empty, click Save
browser_test.assert: validation error shown under Title field, modal remains open, no task added to the list

component_test.assert: no save request is triggered, form/modal closes

browser_test.action: open Add Task modal, click Cancel (or X icon, press Escape, or click outside)
browser_test.assert: modal closes, no new task appears in the task list

test_scenarios.scenario_ref: Add Task — whitespace-only title treated as missing

component_test.assert: whitespace-only title treated as missing, validation error shown under Title field, form remains open

browser_test.assert: validation error shown under Title field, modal remains open, no task added to the list
